meta.notes: Sheltered sun-trap garden (olive + fig thrive). Strong evening/western sun. Two Gardena soil sensors: 'Back Garden' and 'Front Garden'.

plants.name: Fennel
plants.notes: Tall feathery; one NE corner, one SW corner. Self-seeds.

plants.name: Currants
plants.notes: Winter prune (open goblet).

plants.name: Strawberries
plants.notes: Net against birds; runners can be potted on.

plants.name: Espalier apple
plants.notes: Trained flat on wall; summer prune for shape, winter for structure.

plants.name: Globe artichoke
plants.notes: Architectural; mulch crown over winter.

plants.name: Cola plant
plants.notes: Cola-scented southernwood. Confirmed.

plants.name: Jasmine
plants.notes: Scented; prune after flowering.

plants.name: Thyme
plants.notes: By the bench. Trim after flowering.

plants.name: Cherry
plants.notes: Prune in summer (avoid silver leaf risk of winter cuts).

plants.name: Lavender
plants.notes: French lavender (stoechas) by the path. Prune lightly after flowering; never into old wood.

plants.name: Lily
plants.notes: Watch for lily beetle (red).

plants.name: Angel wings
plants.notes: Silver foliage. Confirmed.

plants.name: Canterbury bells
plants.notes: Biennial; let some self-seed.

plants.name: Roses (standard)
plants.notes: Standards near bulb bed. Winter/early-spring prune; deadhead through summer.

plants.name: Echinacea
plants.notes: Coneflower (sketch sp. 'ecchinacia'). Great for pollinators; leave seedheads for goldfinches.

plants.name: Lemon verbena
plants.notes: Tender; protect roots over winter.

plants.name: Mint
plants.notes: Keep contained (pot/bucket) or it runs.

plants.name: Lupins
plants.notes: Watch for lupin aphid.

plants.name: Tansy
plants.notes: Vigorous; can be invasive.

plants.name: Wildflower strips
plants.notes: Pollinator strip.

plants.name: Rosemary
plants.notes: Big feathery specimen centre-right. Light trim after flowering.

plants.name: Broom
plants.notes: Prune after flowering; never into old wood.

plants.name: Curry plant
plants.notes: Silver, curry-scented; trim to keep tidy.

plants.name: Rose (climber)
plants.notes: Tie in laterals horizontally for more flower.

plants.name: Honeysuckle
plants.notes: Scented; prune after flowering.

plants.name: Clematis
plants.notes: Prune group depends on variety — confirm before cutting.

plants.name: Pampas grass
plants.notes: Comb out / cut back old foliage late winter (gloves!).

plants.name: Fig
plants.notes: Thrives in the sun-trap. Prune in summer; protect embryo figs over winter.

plants.name: Wisteria
plants.notes: Two prunes/year: Jul/Aug shorten whippy growth to ~5 buds, Jan/Feb to ~2 buds.

plants.name: Gladioli
plants.notes: Lift corms after frost in colder years.

plants.name: Daffodils
plants.notes: Let foliage die back 6 weeks before tidying.

plants.name: Tulips
plants.notes: Plant Nov; lift if they go blind.

plants.name: Crocus
plants.notes: Early bee forage.

plants.name: Alliums
plants.notes: Leave seedheads — sculptural + loved by bees.

plants.name: Olive
plants.notes: From photos. Confirms sheltered sun-trap. Free-draining; protect in hard frost.

plants.name: Red acer / berberis
plants.notes: Crimson foliage pop (from photo).

plants.name: Dianthus / carnations
plants.notes: White, by the path (from photo).
